name: Portclew House
accommodation: Seven en suite guest rooms plus seven self-catering cottages sleeping 2 to 9
dogs: No pets in the guest house (Visit Pembrokeshire); ask for cottages
confirmedFeatures: Free Wi-Fi, gardens, packed lunches, cots and highchairs; Coach House with hot tub, sauna and outdoor shower
overview: Portclew House is a Georgian country house a few minutes from Freshwater East beach, offering seven en suite B&B rooms and seven self-catering cottages in its grounds. There is free parking and spacious gardens.
surfTripFit: The mix of rooms and larger cottages suits groups, with the beach only minutes away.
